findings.title: Epistemic handoff into responsible action
findings.claim: The focus's greater-knowing clause turns an unresolved human duration estimate into a handoff of the unknown, after which the group can act on food and safety without pretending to solve the chronology.
findings.mechanism: The carrier أَعْلَمُ names superior knowing after the day-or-part-day estimate; the wider awakenings and corrected estimates in 2:259, 30:56, and 23:113 contact that carrier and make the shift from speculative timing to practical action legible.
findings.reader_payoff: The move to the food mission becomes a consequence of disciplined epistemic limitation rather than an unrelated change of topic.
findings.containment: This does not claim that every duration passage has one doctrine or that the external targets supply target-side lexical branches; their target morphology is not supplied.

epistemic.reason: The focus branch and trusted anchored finding are direct, while the wider connection rows are retrieval nominations with exact target Arabic but no target morphology; the represented reader records are legacy-unbound.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyi bilme, tanıma ve gerçeğine uygun biçimde kavrama durumu bilgisizliğin karşıtıdır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus's أَعْلَمُ carries the group's correction from an approximate duration claim to superior knowledge of what they remained.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied wider connections repeat awakening, a day-or-part-day estimate, and knowledgeable correction in 2:259, 30:56, and 23:113; the supplied later context also repeats the surrender of counting before practical responsibility.
branch_activations.activation: Those independent duration-correction patterns contact the focus's knowledge carrier and explain why the following commands begin only after the group stops claiming an exact measure.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Human uncertainty is not resolved by a better human number; it is bounded by acknowledged superior knowledge and redirected into careful action.
branch_activations.boundary: The activation concerns the epistemic handoff and its practical consequence, not a universal theory of time or a lexical reading imported from the target ayahs.

findings.title: Care enacted as discreet conduct
findings.claim: The discretion command can be read as human-scale care that preserves a hidden group through small, gentle, low-detectability action.
findings.mechanism: The carrier يَتَلَطَّفْ contacts both the care facet and the fine, hard-to-perceive facet of the focus branch; wider al-Latif care, provision, and unobtrusive attention give those two facets an independent field of action.
findings.reader_payoff: The envoy's caution becomes the active continuation of the protection that made the sleepers' return possible, not merely a request for politeness.
findings.containment: The finding does not make the human envoy divine, collapse gentleness into secrecy, or claim that every hidden act is protective; target-side morphology in the connection rows is not supplied.

epistemic.reason: The focus carrier, branch facets, and trusted publication are supplied; the represented wide-context record is legacy-unbound and the external connections provide exact target Arabic without target morphology.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir kişiye şefkat göstermek, onu gözetmek, ona iyilik etmek ve değer vermek bu çekirdeğin kişiler arası görünümüdür.
branch_activations.carrier: The command yatalattaf directs the envoy to conduct the mission with care toward the concealed companions.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The prior cave preservation context and the wider al-Latif links in 42:19 and 12:100 supply care that works through measured provision and indirect protection.
branch_activations.activation: That care-and-protection pattern contacts the focus's human imperative, making the envoy's conduct an enacted form of guarding rather than a social courtesy alone.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Discretion carries a positive obligation to protect the vulnerable while delivering what they need.
branch_activations.boundary: The facet is the human care dimension of the act; it does not transfer a divine attribute to the envoy or erase the separate low-detectability facet.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Hafif hareket, ince işlerle uğraşma ve duyularla algılanamayacak kadar ince şeyler fiziksel çekirdeğin uzantılarıdır.
branch_activations.carrier: The same jussive command requires the envoy to make the movement fine-grained and difficult to detect.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The cave scene's low-disturbance preservation and the wider links to unobtrusive attention and concealed danger provide an independent hidden-action trigger.
branch_activations.activation: The external and local hidden-action patterns contact the branch's fine-movement facet, so the command specifies how the mission must avoid leaving a perceptual trace.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The errand reproduces at human scale the barely perceptible mode of preservation described around the sleepers.
branch_activations.boundary: This is a qualified subtle-action resonance, not a claim that the envoy becomes imperceptible or that all secrecy is ethically positive.

findings.title: Awakening becomes commissioned movement
findings.claim: The two occurrences of بَعَثَ make awakening the beginning of commissioned movement: the group is roused, then one member is sent toward a task.
findings.mechanism: The first carrier uses the raising facet for the group, while the second uses the sending facet for the delegated agent; wider raising/restoration and dispatch scenes provide independent contacts for those distinct uses.
findings.reader_payoff: Being awakened is shown as an activation into responsibility, not a return to passive life between the cave and the city.
findings.containment: The external scenes are not declared identical to the cave episode, and the packet does not settle a resurrection reading for the focus's first occurrence; their target morphology is not supplied.

epistemic.reason: Both focus carriers and branch facets are directly supplied, while the wider connections are discovery nominations with exact target Arabic but no target-side morphology.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Uyuyan kişi uyarılarak uykudan çıkarılır ve uyanması sağlanır.

branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied raising/restoration scene in 2:260 and the explicit بعث form in 72:7 provide wider contacts for bringing a dormant or lifeless state into active consequence.
branch_activations.activation: Those independent raising contacts make the focus's awakening the enabling event for what follows, rather than an isolated description of sleep ending.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The group is awakened into an actionable state that immediately supports inquiry and mission.
branch_activations.boundary: The activation preserves the focus's ordinary awakening sense and does not import the target passages' doctrinal framing.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir gönderici, başka bir katılımcıyı belirli bir ihtiyaç, görev, yön veya hedef doğrultusunda yollar.

branch_activations.independent_trigger: The wider dispatch scenes in 4:35 and 12:10 show a group directing a person toward a defined purpose under consequential conditions.
branch_activations.activation: The dispatch facet contacts the focus's delegated-agent grammar and completes the movement from restored capacity to assigned action.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The awakened group converts renewed capacity into a targeted, accountable mission carried by one representative.
branch_activations.boundary: The external dispatch scenes do not determine the focus's social or moral setting; only the sending mechanism is retained.

findings.title: Uncertainty is shared through reciprocal inquiry

findings.mechanism: The carrier يَتَسَاءَلُوا explicitly marks reciprocal questioning; the matching wider scenes in 37:27 and 37:50 return through the same mutual-questioning act.
findings.reader_payoff: The duration problem becomes a communal calibration process before the group chooses its next action.
findings.containment: This does not claim that the wider scenes share the focus's duration question or theological setting; the supported relation is the reciprocal inquiry mechanism only.

epistemic.reason: The focus form and branch facet are supplied, and both target ayahs provide exact Arabic for reciprocal questioning; target morphology beyond the supplied surface is absent.

findings.reader_payoff: The errand reads as a mediated receipt of sustenance, not only as a private shopping trip.
findings.containment: The ordinary food sense remains intact; this does not identify a specific unseen provider for the scene or replace the concrete purchase and return.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Alıcıya yararlanacağı bir şey verilir veya onun için bir pay ayrılır.

branch_activations.independent_trigger: 29:60 presents provision as something not carried by the recipient yet supplied to it, while 42:19 joins provision to measured care that reaches those for whom it is intended.

branch_activations.boundary: Only the provision-as-received-share facet is activated; no claim is made that the focus specifies the external passages' complete theology of provision.

findings.title: Food selection carries an ethical screen
findings.claim: The azka food criterion can carry a bounded ethical-quality sense: the envoy screens for provision that is lawful, good, and not harmful, rather than choosing only by appetite.
findings.mechanism: The carrier أَزْكَىٰ is an elative attached to food; 16:114 and 5:88 independently pair eating with good or lawful provision, returning the purity branch through the focus's selection act.
findings.reader_payoff: The inspection of food becomes a safety and moral-quality test embedded in survival planning.
findings.containment: The focus still concerns concrete food selection, and this does not impose a complete legal system or decide which item in the city passes the test.

epistemic.reason: The focus elative and food-specific branch facet are supplied; the wider food-quality connections have exact target Arabic but no target-side morphology.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Yiyecek için kullanıldığında dinen izin verilen, iyi ve sonradan zarar doğurmayan seçeneği belirtir.

branch_activations.independent_trigger: 16:114 and 5:88 explicitly connect eating with provision that is good or lawful, giving the focus's food comparison an independent quality-and-safety contact.
branch_activations.activation: The external food-quality relation contacts the focus's elative selection and turns purity from a vague preference into a bounded screening obligation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The envoy is sent to discriminate among foods by a quality that protects the group as well as feeds it.
branch_activations.boundary: The activated facet is the food-specific quality edge, not every moral or financial use of the root.

findings.title: Concealment is a perceptual-security protocol
findings.claim: The final prohibition guards against being noticed: concealment is an active perceptual-security requirement attached to the envoy's conduct.
findings.mechanism: The causative perception carrier يُشْعِرَنَّ makes the prohibited outcome another person's awareness of the group; wider scenes of concealed danger and coordinated vigilance provide independent security triggers.
findings.reader_payoff: The instruction's final clause explains why fine conduct matters: success is measured by preventing detection, not merely by returning with food.
findings.containment: This does not claim that concealment is always virtuous or that the wider security scenes share the focus's purpose; the packet supplies no target-side morphology beyond exact Arabic.

epistemic.reason: The focus causative perception analysis and branch facet are supplied; the wider security connections are contextual nominations with exact target Arabic but no target-side morphology.
